class.name: PDFReader
class.brief_description: Reads and renders PDF documents through PDFium.
class.description: Each reader holds one document. Pages, characters, attachments, signatures and object paths use zero-based indices. Geometry uses native PDF point coordinates with Y increasing upward. Pixel coordinates use the top-left of the full rendered page. Results are Godot values and remain usable after [method close]. Check [method get_capabilities] to discover available groups. A missing capability sets [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE]. If the document has no matching content, the method returns an empty result with [constant OK]. Use [method get_last_error] to distinguish these cases. Fields for absent optional data may be omitted. PDF enum values in result dictionaries use the codes in the PDFium public headers. Embedded scripts, XFA data and signature contents are returned for inspection.

method.name: close
method.description: Closes the current document and clears the last error. Safe to call repeatedly.

method.name: find_text
method.description: Capability [code]text[/code]. Finds Unicode [param query] on [param page_index] using [param flags] from [enum FindFlags]. Each match contains [code]start[/code] and [code]count[/code] in PDFium characters and [code]rects[/code] in PDF points.

method.name: get_annotation_string
method.description: Capability [code]annotations[/code]. Reads the string or name at PDF dictionary [param key] on annotation [param annotation_index] of [param page_index]. Returns an empty string when the value is absent.

method.name: get_attachment_data
method.description: Capability [code]attachments[/code]. Returns the decoded contents of attachment [param index] as bytes.

method.name: get_attachments
method.description: Capability [code]attachments[/code]. Returns attachment metadata with available fields [code]index, name, description, mime_type, relationship, size, CreationDate, ModDate, CheckSum[/code]. The size is in bytes.

method.name: get_capabilities
method.description: Returns available PDFium capability identifiers. The identifiers are [code]core, document, thumbnail, text, navigation, web_links, annotations, forms, attachments, signatures, structure, page_objects, javascript, xfa[/code].

method.name: get_char_info
method.description: Capability [code]text[/code]. Returns character data for [param char_index] on [param page_index]. Fields include [code]index, unicode, generated, hyphen, unicode_map_error, angle, font_size, font_weight, font_name, font_flags, bounds, loose_bounds, origin, transform, fill_color, stroke_color[/code]. The angle is in radians.

method.name: get_document_info
method.description: Capability [code]document[/code]. Returns [code]version[/code] (e.g. 17 for PDF 1.7), [code]page_count[/code], [code]valid_cross_reference_table[/code], [code]permissions[/code], [code]user_permissions[/code], [code]security_handler_revision[/code], [code]form_type[/code], [code]tagged[/code], [code]language[/code], [code]permanent_id[/code], [code]changing_id[/code], [code]trailer_ends[/code] and [code]viewer_preferences[/code]. Viewer preferences contain [code]print_scaling[/code], [code]copies[/code], [code]duplex[/code] and [code]print_page_range[/code]. File identifiers are raw bytes.

method.name: get_form_fields
method.description: Capability [code]forms[/code]. Returns AcroForm widgets on [param page_index] with [code]annotation_index, name, alternate_name, value, export_value, type, flags, checked, rect, options[/code]. Each option contains [code]index, label, selected[/code].

method.name: get_javascript_actions
method.description: Capability [code]javascript[/code]. Returns document JavaScript actions with [code]index, name, script[/code]. The script is returned as text.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the last operation's error on this instance. A successful query clears the error, including a query that finds no content.

method.name: get_last_error_message
method.description: Returns the last operation's diagnostic message, or an empty string on success.

method.name: get_metadata
method.description: Capability [code]document[/code]. Returns the available PDF information dictionary strings [code]Title, Author, Subject, Keywords, Creator, Producer, CreationDate, ModDate[/code].

method.name: get_named_destinations
method.description: Capability [code]navigation[/code]. Returns destination dictionaries with [code]name[/code] and the fields described in [method get_page_links].

method.name: get_outline
method.description: Capability [code]navigation[/code]. Returns a bookmark tree. Each entry contains [code]title, count, style, destination, action, children[/code] and optional [code]color[/code]. Destinations and actions use the fields described in [method get_page_links].

method.name: get_page_annotations
method.description: Capability [code]annotations[/code]. Returns annotations on [param page_index] with available fields [code]index, subtype, flags, author, contents, subject, modified, rect, color, interior_color, quads, vertices, ink_paths, line, border[/code]. Border components are horizontal radius, vertical radius and width.

method.name: get_page_char_count
method.description: Capability [code]text[/code]. Counts PDFium character indices on [param page_index], including generated separators.

method.name: get_page_count
method.description: Capability [code]core[/code]. Returns the number of pages in the open document.

method.name: get_page_info
method.description: Capability [code]document[/code]. Returns [code]page_index, size_pt, rotation, has_transparency, label, boxes[/code] for [param page_index]. Rotation is in clockwise degrees. The [code]boxes[/code] dictionary contains any available PDF point rectangles [code]media, crop, bleed, trim, art, bounds[/code].

method.name: get_page_links
method.description: Capability [code]navigation[/code]. Returns explicit links on [param page_index] with [code]rect, quads, destination, action[/code]. A destination can contain [code]page_index, view, parameters, x, y, zoom[/code]. An action can contain [code]type, uri, file_path, destination[/code]. The type and view are PDFium numeric codes. A remote destination may lack a resolvable page index.

method.name: get_page_object_font_data
method.description: Capability [code]page_objects[/code]. Returns the font program bytes PDFium uses for the text object at [param object_path] on [param page_index].

method.name: get_page_object_image
method.description: Capability [code]page_objects[/code]. Returns an RGBA8 image for the image object at [param object_path] on [param page_index]. Enable [param rendered] to include the image matrix and mask. The bitmap limits from [method render_page] apply.

method.name: get_page_object_image_data
method.description: Capability [code]page_objects[/code]. Returns stream bytes for the image object at [param object_path] on [param page_index]. Enable [param decoded] to apply the PDF stream filters that PDFium supports for this API.

method.name: get_page_objects
method.description: Capability [code]page_objects[/code]. Returns a tree of objects on [param page_index]. Common fields are [code]path, type, marked_content_id, has_transparency, active, bounds, rotated_bounds, transform, fill_color, stroke_color, stroke_width, line_join, line_cap, dash_phase, dash_array[/code]. Text adds [code]text, font_size, text_render_mode, font[/code]. Font fields are [code]family, base_name, embedded, flags, weight[/code]. Paths add [code]segments, fill_mode, stroke[/code] and each segment has [code]type, point, close[/code]. Images add [code]pixel_size, dpi, bits_per_pixel, color_space, filters[/code]. Form objects add [code]children[/code]. Use [code]path[/code] for follow-up extraction.

method.name: get_page_structure
method.description: Capability [code]structure[/code]. Returns the tagged structure tree for [param page_index]. Element fields are [code]type, title, alt_text, actual_text, language, id, expansion, marked_content_id, marked_content_ids, attributes, children[/code]. Marked-content children may contain just [code]marked_content_id[/code]. Attribute dictionaries map names to a [code]type[/code] code and an optional [code]value[/code].

method.name: get_page_text
method.description: Capability [code]text[/code]. Returns Unicode text on [param page_index] from [param start] for [param count] PDFium characters. A count of -1 reads to the end. Unmapped characters can be omitted from the resulting string.

method.name: get_page_text_in_rect
method.description: Capability [code]text[/code]. Returns Unicode text within the PDF point [param rect] on [param page_index].

method.name: get_page_thumbnail
method.description: Capability [code]thumbnail[/code]. Returns the embedded thumbnail for [param page_index] as RGBA8, or [code]null[/code] if the page has none.

method.name: get_page_web_links
method.description: Capability [code]web_links[/code]. Returns URLs detected in the text on [param page_index]. Entries contain [code]uri, rects, start, count[/code].

method.name: get_signature_contents
method.description: Capability [code]signatures[/code]. Returns the raw PDF signature contents at [param index] for inspection.

method.name: get_signatures
method.description: Capability [code]signatures[/code]. Returns [code]index, subfilter, time, reason, doc_mdp_permission, byte_range[/code] for each signature. The byte range contains alternating offsets and lengths.

method.name: get_text_rects
method.description: Capability [code]text[/code]. Returns PDF point rectangles for [param count] characters starting at [param start] on [param page_index]. A count of -1 selects to the end.

method.name: get_xfa_packets
method.description: Capability [code]xfa[/code]. Returns embedded XFA packets with [code]index, name, data[/code]. Packet data is returned as bytes.

method.name: hit_test_text
method.description: Capability [code]text[/code]. Finds the character index near [param position] on [param page_index] within the horizontal and vertical [param tolerance] in points. Returns -1 on a miss or error.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns whether the core PDFium library can be loaded.

method.name: is_open
method.description: Returns whether this reader holds an open document.

method.name: open_buffer
method.description: Opens a PDF from [param bytes] with an optional [param password]. The reader retains the bytes until the document closes. A failed attempt preserves the open document. Returns [constant OK] on success.

method.name: open_file
method.description: Opens [param path] through [FileAccess]. Supply [param password] for an encrypted document. A failed attempt preserves the open document. Returns [constant OK] on success.

method.name: page_to_pixel
method.description: Capability [code]core[/code]. Converts a PDF point [param position] on [param page_index] to an integer pixel position in the full bitmap at [param dpi] and additional [param rotation].

method.name: pixel_to_page
method.description: Capability [code]core[/code]. Converts [param position] from the full bitmap at [param dpi] and additional [param rotation] to a PDF point on [param page_index].

method.name: render_page
method.description: Capability [code]core[/code]. Renders [param page_index] at [param dpi] to an RGBA8 image over [param background]. Use [param flags] from [enum RenderFlags]. Additional clockwise [param rotation] must be 0, 90, 180, or 270 degrees. Output is limited to 8192 pixels per side and 64 MiB. Form widgets require [code]forms[/code].

method.name: render_region
method.description: Capability [code]core[/code]. Renders only [param region] of [param page_index]. Measure the region from the top-left of the full bitmap at [param dpi] and additional [param rotation]. The region must be inside the full page. The bitmap limits, [param flags] and [param background] work as in [method render_page].

constants.constant: Allows consecutive search matches to overlap.
